dm.notMember: This private chat is for members of the Dragon Ball FR server. Join it to talk with me.
dm.busy: I am still answering your previous message: wait a moment before sending another one.
dm.rateLimited: You reached the limit of {limit} messages in {minutes} min. Try again in {wait} min.
dm.queued: Several people are talking to me right now: you are number {position} in the queue, I will answer as soon as I can.
dm.queueFull: Too many requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
dm.timeout: The answer took too long. Ask a shorter question or try again later.
dm.unavailable: The model is unavailable for the moment. Try again a little later.
dm.attachmentOnly: I only read the text of private messages: write me your question.

interaction.failed: ❌ The command hit an internal error. Try again in a moment.
interaction.unknown: Unknown or expired command. Reload Discord (Ctrl+R) to refresh the list.
interaction.paginationExpired: This pagination has expired. Run the command again to keep reading.
